--- title: "[StepClassDistance]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Replace numeric columns with per-row distances to each class centroid. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/step_class_distance.py#L363-L590){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python StepClassDistance( columns, outcome, *, metric="euclidean", log_distance=True, eps=0.001, prefix="distance", keep_original_cols=False, role="predictor", id=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The selected columns are read to learn one centroid per outcome class, then replaced by one ``distance_`` column per class holding each row's distance to that class's centroid, or kept alongside them when ``keep_original_cols`` is ``True``. Each distance is computed from all the selected columns at once, so no distance column belongs to any one of them. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [columns]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Selector]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Columns to measure distances over. Accepts a single column name, a list of names, a shoez selector such as ``Selectors.numeric_predictors()`` (see `Selectors` for the full set), or a narwhals or polars selector (``narwhals.selectors.numeric()``, ``polars.selectors.numeric()``). Selectors are resolved against the frame's schema when the recipe is fitted, so the same selector works on any backend. Only numeric columns are meaningful here. [outcome]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Name of the column in the training frame that holds the class labels. Read at fit time only; the column is *not* declared as an input feature in `schema_in()`. [metric]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Metric]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["euclidean"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Distance function: ``"euclidean"`` (default) or ``"manhattan"``. [log_distance]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether to return ``log(distance + eps)`` instead of raw distances. Default ``True``. [eps]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.001]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Offset inside the log (only used when ``log_distance`` is ``True``). Default ``0.001``. [prefix]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["distance"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Prefix for the new column names. Default ``"distance"`` gives ``distance_``. [keep_original_cols]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If ``True``, the source columns are kept alongside the distance columns instead of being dropped. Default ``False``. [role]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["predictor"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Role assigned to the new distance columns. Default ``"predictor"``. [id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Stable step identifier. Default ``"class_distance"``. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} The two numeric columns are replaced by one ``distance_`` column per class label found in ``outcome``: ::: {#0bedb2ad .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} df = pd.DataFrame( { "x": [0.0, 1.0, 10.0, 11.0], "y": [0.0, 1.0, 10.0, 11.0], "label": ["a", "a", "b", "b"], } ) df ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
x y label
0 0.0 0.0 a
1 1.0 1.0 a
2 10.0 10.0 b
3 11.0 11.0 b
``` ::: ::: Specifying the step touches no data, so the recipe reports itself as untrained: ::: {#5b73329b .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} recipe = Recipe().add( StepClassDistance( s.numeric_predictors(), outcome="label", log_distance=False ) ) recipe ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Recipe (untrained) Inputs: no roles assigned Steps: step_class_distance(select(role='predictor', type=NumericType)) [untrained] ``` ::: ::: `fit()` learns one centroid per class label and returns a trained recipe: ::: {#840cddff .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Recipe (trained) Inputs: 3 columns — 3 predictors Steps: step_class_distance(x, y → distance_a, distance_b) [trained] ``` ::: ::: `transform()` then replaces the numeric columns with one ``distance_`` column per label: ::: {#25193696 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}
label distance_a distance_b
0 a 0.707107 14.849242
1 a 0.707107 13.435029
2 b 13.435029 0.707107
3 b 14.849242 0.707107
``` ::: ::: ``log_distance`` (the default) compresses the raw distances: ::: {#07b18f02 .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} recipe = Recipe().add( StepClassDistance(s.numeric_predictors(), outcome="label") ) fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=6} ```{=html}
label distance_a distance_b
0 a -0.345160 2.698016
1 a -0.345160 2.597940
2 b 2.597940 -0.345160
3 b 2.698016 -0.345160
``` ::: ::: ``keep_original_cols`` keeps the source columns alongside the distances: ::: {#ccca1b65 .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} recipe = Recipe().add( StepClassDistance( s.numeric_predictors(), outcome="label", keep_original_cols=True ) ) fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=7} ```{=html}
x y label distance_a distance_b
0 0.0 0.0 a -0.345160 2.698016
1 1.0 1.0 a -0.345160 2.597940
2 10.0 10.0 b 2.597940 -0.345160
3 11.0 11.0 b 2.698016 -0.345160
``` ::: :::
